== Smart Punctuation

This is an em dash -- used for emphasis.

This is an en dash for ranges: pages 10-20.

An ellipsis... appears here.

Curly apostrophe: it's a test.

Double curly quotes: "Hello, World!"

Single curly quotes: 'Hello, World!'

Right square bracket: {endsb}

Two colons: {two-colons}

Right single quote: {rsquo}

Right double quote: {rdquo}

== HTML Special Characters

Ampersand & less-than < greater-than > double-quote " single-quote '

== Unicode Characters

Accented: é è ê ë ñ ü ö ä ß

Greek: α β γ δ ε ζ η θ

Mathematical: ∑ ∏ ∫ ∞ √ ≠ ≤ ≥
